sessions.name: Batch 0: Prototype (50 producers)
sessions.notes: 46 producers, 1,677 wines, 889 wine_grapes, 894 vintages, 3,967 external_ids, 2,335 TTB linked. sessions.name: Batch 1 Part 1 (500 producers)
sessions.notes: 542 producers, 16,524 wines, 8,551 wine_grapes, 28,781 COLAs, 16,524 LWIN IDs, 4,842 vintages. Grape-in-cuvee fix. Josh Test 47/50=94%. 80.9% appellation coverage, 51.7% grape coverage, 96.8% color. 1 Joh. Jos. Prum duplicate cleaned. 10 producers with 0 wines (no-LWIN grocery brands).

sessions.name: Batch 1 Part 2 (depth + enrichment)
sessions.notes: Archive recovery via LWIN bridge. +14,021 vintages (5,123 wines), +8,708 grapes (11,444 wines), +1,947 scores (630 wines), +13,980 prices (1,296 wines), +330 farming certs, +2,214 label designations, +5,736 external_ids (UPC/QR). +1,027 appellation_id, +780 region_id, +311 color, +9,943 varietal_category_id, +1,184 wine_type (sparkling/fortified).
